name: GLM-5.3
attention_variant: MLA + DSA sparse attention indexer (index_topk 2048), kv_lora_rank 512
notes: Largest open GLM and the current frontier of the line: safetensors total 753.33B. The card states GLM-5.3 reuses the GLM-5.2 base model and that all gains are post-training, so GLM-5.2 and 5.3 share this exact config - recorded once, with 5.3 as the current release. Architecture glm_moe_dsa = MoE + MLA + DSA sparse attention. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 78 layers x (kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64) x 2 = 78 x 576 x 2 = 89,856 B/token (87.8 KiB). That is excellent for a 753B model: compare DeepSeek-V3's 68.6 KiB. The cache cost is dominated by layer count, not total params, so a very large MoE can still be cheap in KV. index_topk 2048 with a sparse-attention indexer (HF GlmMoeDsaAttention) selects the attended positions - a decode compute saver, not a cache saver. MoE: 256 routed + 1 shared, 8 per token, first_k_dense_replace 3, moe_intermediate_size 2048, intermediate 12288. hidden 6144, head_dim 192, qk_nope 192, qk_rope 64, v_head_dim 256, q_lora_rank 2048. Context 1048576, rope_parameters rope_type default rope_theta 8000000. active_params_b is null: the card does not state an activated figure and I did not want to invent one. Our config arithmetic gives ~40.9B, which is plausible next to the 355B/32B ratio of GLM-4.5, but it is derived, not vendor-stated - treat as indicative only.
